Sun.mantra: Aditya Hridayam or Om Hraam Hreem Hraum Sah Suryaya Namah
Sun.advice: Use this dasha for career advancement. Respect authorities. Be mindful of ego. Father's health may be concern.
Sun.spiritual_significance: Soul awakening; dharmic action; past life leadership karma activated

Moon.mantra: Om Shraam Shreem Shraum Sah Chandraya Namah
Moon.advice: Emotional period — cultivate inner peace. Good for public-facing work. Mother's wellbeing important.
Moon.spiritual_significance: Emotional purification; maternal karma; public service
Moon.average_peak_period: First 4 years if Moon is waxing in natal chart

Mars.mantra: Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namah
Mars.advice: Channel energy productively. Avoid unnecessary conflicts. Good for real estate. Stay careful about accidents.
Mars.spiritual_significance: Courage activation; karmic battles; brotherly bonds

Rahu.mantra: Om Raam Rahave Namah or Durga Saptashati
Rahu.advice: Most unpredictable dasha. Focus on spirituality. Beware of illusions. Great for unconventional success if Rahu is well-placed.
Rahu.spiritual_significance: Karmic amplification; past life debts; illusion dissolution

Jupiter.mantra: Om Graam Greem Graum Sah Guruve Namah
Jupiter.advice: Best dasha for spiritual growth and wisdom. Pursue education and dharmic activities. Marriage-children favorable period.
Jupiter.spiritual_significance: Dharma activation; guru connection; past life merit reward

house_effects.7th_lord: Maraka — delayed marriage or partner health

Saturn.mantra: Om Pram Prim Prom Sah Shanaischaraya Namah
Saturn.advice: Longest dasha — 19 years. Patience is key. Hard work will eventually be rewarded. Focus on karma yoga.
Saturn.spiritual_significance: Karmic reckoning; discipline; service; liberation through work
Saturn.average_peak_period: Last 7 years after initial struggle phase

Mercury.mantra: Om Braam Breem Braum Sah Budhaya Namah
Mercury.advice: Excellent dasha for business, education, and communication. Adaptability is key. Keep commitments.
Mercury.spiritual_significance: Discernment; intellectual karma; communication of truth

Ketu.mantra: Om Sraam Sreem Sraum Sah Ketave Namah
Ketu.advice: Highly spiritual dasha. Good for sadhana and letting go. Avoid forced material pursuits. Trust intuition.
Ketu.spiritual_significance: Moksha preparation; past life completion; liberation karma

Venus.mantra: Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namah
Venus.advice: Longest and most pleasant dasha for many. Focus on love, arts, and prosperity. Balance pleasure with responsibility.
Venus.spiritual_significance: Bhakti activation; divine love; beauty as spiritual path
